items.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $731M, highest since January as BTC reclaims $80K
items.snippet: US Bitcoin ETFs drew $730.9 million on Thursday as Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000, though CryptoQuant flagged weak fresh demand and a key $83,000 test.
